body.title: Verification inside apply
body.summary: Add src/workflow/convert/verify.ts: after the marker is written compare the planner's before-snapshot with the snapshot the real delivery reader builds from the converted repository and report each difference without correcting it (a contentHash difference is not reported). Verification runs inside apply only; there is no standalone verify mode. Test src/workflow/convert/__tests__/convert-verify.test.ts: an approved legacy head verifies with no difference, and a planted difference is reported.
acceptanceChecks: An approved legacy head verifies with no difference through the real delivery reader
A planted difference is reported with the unit and the reason

tests.name: convert-verify.test.ts: an approved legacy head verifies with no difference and a planted difference is reported
